item.tib: bla ma rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa las dbang bzhi rgyal po nges pa'i snying khu
item.coloph: kho bo byang chub rdo rje gar gyi dbang phyug gi (gis) me mo lug gi zla tshes la shel brag rdzongs (rdzong) nas/ dngos grub rnyed de/ slar lcags pho khyi yi lo shar rgyal mo rong chen gdan sa/ bkra shis smin grol khrod du shog ser las zhal bshus grub pa'o//
